name: Intrepid Strongbox Key
summary: On the wreck of the Intrepid, Captain Halyndor still guards the key to his strongbox. The rusted iron key once kept a mysterious item locked away aboard the doomed Alliance vessel off the Wetlands.

sections.title: A Captain's Secret
sections.body: The Intrepid was wrecked with the Third Fleet off the Wetlands, and its crew became restless, cursed spirits. Captain Halyndor watched over a mysterious item inside the ship’s heavy strongbox. Now his ghost prowls the waterlogged deck, still clutching the rusted key that opens it.

sections.title: Breaking the Bond
sections.body: Captain Halyndor’s key opens the Intrepid’s strongbox, where a cursed relic anchors the crew to their torment. The relic can be taken to Glorin Steelbrow, a dwarven priest in Menethil Harbor, for cleansing.

faq.q: Who carries the Intrepid Strongbox Key?
faq.answer: Captain Halyndor carries the key as he paces the upper deck of the northern shipwreck off the Wetlands’ northwest coast.

faq.q: What does the Intrepid Strongbox Key open?
faq.answer: The key opens the Intrepid’s Locked Strongbox, submerged in the fractured hull beneath the captain’s deck.

faq.q: Why was the strongbox kept locked?
faq.answer: Captain Halyndor locked a cursed object inside the chest to keep it hidden and secure. After the fleet sank, its lingering evil bound the crew to undeath.

faq.q: Who can cleanse the cursed item inside the chest?
faq.answer: Glorin Steelbrow, a dwarven priest in Menethil Harbor, can cleanse the cursed artifact once the chest is unlocked.

angles.text: As a priest, you can bring the cursed artifact to Glorin Steelbrow in Menethil Harbor for cleansing, freeing the crew’s souls from their torment.
As an Alliance member, you know the key belonged to a commander of the Third Fleet, lost off the coast of Menethil Harbor. Its loss remains an open wound for the harbor’s survivors.
